hints.title: Reachability Tree Construction
hints.text: Build a Kruskal Reconstruction Tree by sorting edges and creating a new auxiliary node for each merged component with edge weight as value.

hints.title: Binary Lifting for Lowest Common Ancestor
hints.text: Precompute 2^k ancestor jumps up to the tree root using binary lifting.

hints.title: Bottleneck Path Query
hints.text: The minimum bottleneck weight between u and v equals the value of their lowest common ancestor in the reconstruction tree. Check if this value is strictly less than limit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(E log E + N log N) init, O(log N) per query
complexity.notes: Constructs Kruskal reconstruction tree and answers online bottleneck queries via binary lifting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running fresh BFS/DFS per query takes O(Q * (N + E)) time, which exceeds time limits for online queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary lifting tables enable logarithmic online query response.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Kruskal Reconstruction Tree with binary lifting to query maximum edge weight along minimum bottleneck paths.
